parameters.name: Pre
parameters.description: Input gain driving the transfer curve
parameters.mixImpact: Controls how much signal hits the non-linear curve portion
parameters.safetyNotes: Higher values increase distortion; compensate with Post gain

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.mixImpact: Higher values = more processed signal; lower = more original
parameters.safetyNotes: Use 20-50% for subtle enhancement, 100% for effect

parameters.name: Post
parameters.mixImpact: Critical for matching processed and unprocessed levels
parameters.safetyNotes: Adjust to prevent channel or master bus clipping

parameters.name: Center
parameters.mixImpact: Prevents cumulative DC buildup on buses
parameters.safetyNotes: Leave enabled except for experimental purposes

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.safetyNotes: Unipolar safer for mixing; Bipolar more aggressive

parameters.name: Oversample
parameters.description: Internal processing rate multiplier for aliasing reduction
parameters.safetyNotes: Use 4x+ for hard clipping or high-frequency sources

parameters.name: HQ
parameters.description: High-quality processing for ultra-low level signals
parameters.safetyNotes: Slight CPU increase; use for critical applications

transferCurve.description: Custom transfer function mapping input to output amplitude
